name: generic-extracted
_note: The normalized CSV shape: written by the deterministic PDF extractors in scripts/, by the extract-statement skill, and by any hand-rolled export. The shape alone cannot say who produced it, so it is not what decides whether reconciliation is required: pipeline/extraction.py gates the scripts/ extractors on the report they return, and pipeline/ingest.py requires a <name>.report.json for any file named '*.extracted.csv' (what the skill writes). Either way, opening + rows == closing is re-checked here, over this file, before a row is imported.
